intentionsPage.explainer: Nothing is attached to an intention. An item counts towards every intention whose project scope and category it matches, when its list starts inside the window — so one page can count towards a grant, a regional target and Overall output at once. Those figures overlap and are never added. Planned and delivered are plan completion: what was put on lists in the window, and how much of that was digitized in it. Output is everything digitized in the window, whenever it was planned — what a mix is measured on. The counting start is fixed once created. To count from another date, make a new intention from the old one.

intentionCard.mixExplanation: Intended is the mix{{scope}}; planned is over the {{planned}} pp on lists starting in its window; output is over the {{output}} pp digitized in it, whenever they were planned. Drift is output minus intended, in points; {{band}} is display tolerance, not a change to the mix.

mixPage.explainer: Shares are recursive. Share of parent is what is stored; of the whole is it times its parent’s, worked out on read. They are percentages, not weights: a share set to 30% is 30% tomorrow. No share is unallocated and flagged; 0% is a deliberate exclusion. A category holds no share of its own: these numbers are {{mix}}.
